title: Friday the 13th
review: It's a bit too slick, Hollywoody and generic. There are some theoretically gnarly head stabs, but they all use CGI which diminishes the perverse tactile pleasure of seeing a rubber face full of fake blood get pierced. There's none of the scruffy rawness that makes the original run endearing. It is full of 00s American cultural artefacts, including the Bieber hair, beer pong, wakeboarding and a Cadillac Escalade. The camera is just as shakey as {Resident Evil 5} during the chases and kills. Some of the characters are so similar visually, and in their performances, than I struggled to remember who was who as I was still watching. An entirely forgettable entry in the series, bringing nothing to the table except enhanced visual fidelity.
